note: Scandals happen only to fictional politicians, at identical odds for every party. {name} is the politician. severity above 0.85 forces a resignation.

scandals.text: {name} billed the public for a long list of personal expenses.
{name} turns out not to live in the district they represent.
{name} put three relatives on the public payroll.
{name} steered a public contract to a business partner.
{name} spent campaign funds on a boat.
{name}'s resume lists a degree the university has no record of.
{name} missed most of this year's votes while drawing a full salary.
{name} is charged with taking kickbacks from a road contractor.
{name} was recorded insulting their own constituents.
{name} bought land just before voting to rezone it.
{name} kept employees on the books who never existed.
{name}'s signature bill was copied word for word from a lobbyist's draft.
